# `adt function`

ABAP function group and function module operations

```bash
adt function [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command               | Description                     |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `adt function group`  | ABAP function group operations  |
| `adt function module` | ABAP function module operations |

## `adt function group`

ABAP function group operations

```bash
adt function group [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                       | Description                                 |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `adt function group create`   | Create a new ABAP function group            |
| `adt function group read`     | Read source code of an ABAP function group  |
| `adt function group write`    | Write source code to an ABAP function group |
| `adt function group activate` | Activate one or more ABAP function group(s) |
| `adt function group delete`   | Delete an ABAP function group               |

### `adt function group create`

Create a new ABAP function group

```bash
adt function group create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description         | Default |
| --------------- | ------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | function group name |         |
| `<description>` | Short description   |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name        |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                           | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number              |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if function group already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                        |         |

### `adt function group read`

Read source code of an ABAP function group

```bash
adt function group read [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description         | Default |
| -------- | ------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | function group name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                                                     | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                                                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout (avoids shell redirect encoding issues) |         |

### `adt function group write`

Write source code to an ABAP function group

```bash
adt function group write [options] <name> [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                        | Default |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | function group name                |         |
| `[file]` | Source file path (use - for stdin) | `-`     |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `--activate`               | Activate after writing   |         |

### `adt function group activate`

Activate one or more ABAP function group(s)

```bash
adt function group activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description            | Default |
| ------------ | ---------------------- | ------- |
| `<names...>` | function group name(s) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

### `adt function group delete`

Delete an ABAP function group

```bash
adt function group delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description         | Default |
| -------- | ------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | function group name |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |

## `adt function module`

ABAP function module operations

```bash
adt function module [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                        | Description                                      |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `adt function module create`   | Create a new function module in a function group |
| `adt function module read`     | Read source code of a function module            |
| `adt function module write`    | Write source code to a function module           |
| `adt function module activate` | Activate a function module                       |
| `adt function module delete`   | Delete a function module                         |

### `adt function module create`

Create a new function module in a function group

```bash
adt function module create [options] <group> <name> <description>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description          | Default |
| --------------- | -------------------- | ------- |
| `<group>`       | Function group name  |         |
| `<name>`        | Function module name |         |
| `<description>` | Short description    |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                                | Default  |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number                   |          |
| `--processing-type <type>` | Processing type (normal, rfc, update, ...) | `normal` |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if module already exists              | `false`  |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                             |          |

### `adt function module read`

Read source code of a function module

```bash
adt function module read [options] <group> <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument  | Description          | Default |
| --------- | -------------------- | ------- |
| `<group>` | Function group name  |         |
| `<name>`  | Function module name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                             | Default |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                     |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout |         |

### `adt function module write`

Write source code to a function module

```bash
adt function module write [options] <group> <name> [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument  | Description                        | Default |
| --------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<group>` | Function group name                |         |
| `<name>`  | Function module name               |         |
| `[file]`  | Source file path (use - for stdin) | `-`     |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `--activate`               | Activate after writing   |         |

**Arguments**
